title: Isomorphism of coprime abelian-by-cyclic groups

problem.name: Isomorphism of coprime abelian-by-cyclic groups
problem.statement_latex: Given black-box groups $G,H$ promised to have decompositions $A\rtimes\mathbb Z_m$ with $A$ abelian and $\gcd(|A|,m)=1$, decide whether $G\cong H$ and construct an isomorphism. Let $N=\min\{|G|,|H|\}$; input generators and operations have polylogarithmic descriptions.
problem.statement_text: Given black-box groups $G,H$ promised to have decompositions $A\rtimes\mathbb Z_m$ with $A$ abelian and $\gcd(|A|,m)=1$, decide whether $G\cong H$ and construct an isomorphism. Let $N=\min\{|G|,|H|\}$; input generators and operations have polylogarithmic descriptions.

strength.description_latex: Exponential or subexponential to polynomial in the strongest stated regime.
strength.description_text: Exponential or subexponential to polynomial in the strongest stated regime.

evidence.description_latex: The quantum bound improves a published classical algorithm in the stated regime; the comparison is between algorithmic upper bounds.

quantum.headline_latex: $\operatorname{poly}(\log N)$ quantum time by Le Gall, through abelian decomposition and simultaneous matrix-conjugacy calculations.
